chapter: Clubs, readers and musicians he knew
title: Mercedes Gorman, Albert Baptiste and the Silver Leaf Band
summary: Mercedes Gorman played in one of his bands; Albert Baptiste managed the Silver Leaf, which came before the Nola Band.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Gorman Fields, I guess is the name. Mercedes Gorman. Mercedes Gorman, yeah. She played in my band with me. One of them bands, I don't know if it wasn't Enola or the, or the Silver Leaf or one of them. Oh, you had three different bands. Well, yeah, well, Silver Leaf too. But that was, uh, Albert Baptiste was the manager of that. See. Albert Baptiste. What did he say? He was a violin player. Uh huh. And he used to work for one of these corporate companies. But is the Silver Leaf band was after the Enola band? No, that was before.
Oh, that was before. Oh, yeah. First it was Supreme and then the-
Yeah, that's right. Who was in the Silver Leaf?
Huh? You know who was in the Silver Leaf? Well, the only one I can remember, I just called his name.
